name: Me Explaining To My Mom
look: Two side-by-side video stills. Left: a young woman in a tan headwrap, white T-shirt and black jacket gestures with both hands, earnestly explaining something. Right: an older woman lies on a couch under a navy Dallas Cowboys blanket, staring back with a blank, unconvinced look.
use: The left side is someone passionately explaining a niche interest, theory, excuse or piece of internet culture, and the right is the listener's flat, unimpressed stare. The caption usually starts with 'me explaining to my mom'.
slots: caption: 'me explaining to my mom' plus the topic (top)
examples: Me explaining to my mom why I can't pause an online game
Me explaining to my mom that the dishes are soaking, not abandoned
describe: daughter in a headscarf telling her mother something important
girl talking with her hands while her mom lies on the couch staring
woman under a cowboys blanket giving a blank stare
young woman explaining and older woman not buying it
mom on the couch looking unconvinced at her daughter
